meta.style: Bright full-colour cartoon illustration in a clean modern storybook style: bold uniform dark-brown outlines of even weight, flat colour fills with soft simple cel shading, no gradients and no painterly texture, warm cream background, friendly rounded shapes, wholesome and cheerful, expressive exaggerated cartoon acting. Children's English-learning material for six to ten year olds. No written words, speech bubbles, captions or signage anywhere in the image.

characters.CAPTAIN_A: A gentle, handsome young Taiwanese man in his early twenties, tall and slim, soft messy black hair with spiky bangs, warm dark eyes, a shy kind smile, wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt with a small white letter A patch on the chest. Calm, patient, a little bashful; he never looks stern.
characters.FUNKY: A cheerful Taiwanese woman in her fifties, chin-length wavy auburn-brown hair with silver streaks, round rosy cheeks, warm smiling eyes with gentle laugh lines, an enormous crown of colourful flowers, strawberries and small school supplies sitting on her head, a cream cable-knit cardigan over a small-floral blouse, layered colourful beaded necklaces and bracelets. Wildly enthusiastic and expressive, always caught mid-gesture.
characters.REX: A small friendly cartoon dinosaur: a chubby grey-brown long-necked sauropod with soft cream spots, big round expressive eyes, a wide happy smile, wearing a little royal-blue baseball cap with a white letter A and a red paisley bandana around his neck. He rides on CAPTAIN_A's shoulder. Clever, and a little bit of a show-off.

image.prompt: CAPTAIN_A leans down conspiratorially with one hand cupped beside his mouth, whispering a secret; REX sits on his shoulder and tilts his big head in close to listen, one small claw beside his ear. They are in a bright cosy home kitchen corner. Playful mischievous mood, both of them clearly enjoying the secret.

FUNKY bursts into the frame from the left with both hands on her hips and eyes sparkling, holding one shiny red apple triumphantly above her head; CAPTAIN_A jumps in fright with his shoulders up around his ears; REX topples backwards on his shoulder laughing. High-energy comedic entrance in the same kitchen.
